company.description: ICMI Egypt manufactures disposable medical products and nonwoven materials. The company produces medical syringes, infusion sets, surgical supplies, and other healthcare items. It also manufactures nonwoven fabrics for medical and industrial applications. The company operates production facilities that support different product lines. It follows quality control procedures during manufacturing. It supplies products to healthcare providers and distributors.
